candidate.title: Assistant ICT Officer (KBGDSC/09/2026) – Kaabong District Local Government
candidate.description: One post of Assistant ICT Officer (salary scale U5) with Kaabong District Local Government in the Karamoja sub-region. The officer installs and maintains computers, printers and network equipment, gives first-line user support and troubleshooting, keeps the ICT inventory, backups and antivirus up to date, supports data entry and reporting systems, and helps staff use e-services, email and official information systems. Requires a diploma or degree in information technology, computer science or a related field, with knowledge of networking, hardware and operating systems.

additionalRequirements: Diploma or degree in IT, computer science or a related field.
Reference KBGDSC/09/2026; salary scale U5.
